_readme: Copy this file to profiles.json next to index.js and put your own household in it.
profiles.json holds real names, so it is NOT in the repo and deploy-hub.sh never rsyncs it:
it lives only on the box your TV points at. The hub boots from this example when profiles.json
is missing, with generic ids, and says so once in the log.
Fields: id (never shown, used in every URL), name (shown on the TV), kind adult|kids,
age (the ceiling for rules/maturity.js), pinRequired, languages, rules (per-profile rule
overrides; data/profiles.json can patch the same fields at runtime without a restart).
